title: Cycle-conditioned arc covariance for half-memory RPCD
objective: Prove or refute a dimension-free cycle-averaged bound for the adapted signed off-diagonal arc covariance in the half-memory conditional dual hierarchy.
acceptance_checks: Reproduces the skew-Hilbert pathwise and reversal-pair divergences exactly.
Uses the full random-cycle average; it does not claim a pathwise or reversal-only constant.
Separates diagonal and adapted signed off-diagonal arc covariance and preserves local Schur constraints.
Explains whether conditional Pythagorean information gains pay for the target and how the result transfers to expected distance.
